programs.name: ICR Postdoctoral Training Fellow posts (e.g. AI for precision oncology; AI for radiotherapy) - advertised per group
programs.requirements: PhD awarded (or near completion, with confirmation within 6 months of starting); apply to the specific advert
programs.eligibility: Open to external and overseas applicants; the ICR says it supports overseas applicants. Fixed-term posts, with a 7-year cap on time as a PDTF at the ICR. Not a central fellowship competition.
programs.deadline_text: Per-advert; the adverts I saw had end dates in 2026 and look closed. Check the ICR jobs portal for new ones.

programs.name: MRC LMB International PhD Programme (October 2027 entry)
programs.requirements: Application through the University of Cambridge Applicant Portal; qualified applicants of all nationalities. Interviews from 18 January 2027.
programs.eligibility: Welcomes applicants of all nationalities. Up to about 30% of awards are open to international applicants, who pay international fees. This is a full PhD start, not a visit, so it is likely unsuitable for someone already in a PhD.
programs.deadline_text: Applications open 10 Sep 2026 and close 8 Dec 2026; interviews from 18 Jan 2027
